subject: Game Theory
title: Predatory Pricing
description: Learn Predatory Pricing in one minute.

hook.text: A large firm drops prices below cost to drive a smaller rival out of business. Then it raises prices.

buildup.text: Predatory pricing is illegal in most countries, but proving intent is notoriously difficult.

discovery.text: The predator loses money short-term but gains monopoly power long-term if the rival exits.

twist.text: Game theory shows predation is often irrational: the losses exceed the gains unless the predator is much larger.

climax.text: Uber lost billions undercutting taxi prices. The strategy assumes competitors eventually give up.

punchline.text: Losing money on purpose is a power play.

quiz.question: Why is predatory pricing risky for the predator?
